title: First-Month Route Desk
summary: Tracks early Ashfall routes from safe caches into faction signals, hazard warnings, and relay work without sending the player into late-game danger.
nextSteps: Confirm the Survivor Cache Signal before leaving shelter.
Scan the route target, then open the linked Index field guide entry.
Track one HoloMap marker at a time and note its risk label.
Complete optional faction or hazard prep side-ops only when supplied.
Return to base after each route to claim rewards and update What Now.
